2. Or merge the PR yourself, and I'll pick up from the post-merge board read (execution-observation is the natural next role once the fix lands on main) — the re-run/verify steps will still need at least `git fetch`/`pytest` to be allowed.

The moment any of those commands goes through, I'll complete verify → merge → re-test and give the full 4-part report in the same turn.
